title: Viết lại câu cùng nghĩa (2)
intro: Viết lại sao cho NGHĨA KHÔNG ĐỔI. Dạng hay gặp: so sánh (taller ↔ shorter), Let's / What about…?, There are… ↔ … has…, a good singer ↔ sings well.
instruction: Hoàn thành câu thứ hai sao cho nghĩa giống câu thứ nhất (chỉ gõ phần còn thiếu).

answers: are eight hundred students in my school
are eight hundred students at my school

items.prompt: Hue is smaller than Ha Noi.
Nobody in my class is taller than Nam.
answers: the tallest student in my class
the tallest boy in my class
the tallest person in my class
the tallest student in the class
the tallest boy in the class
the tallest person in the class
taller than anyone else in my class
taller than everyone else in my class
taller than any other student in my class
items.explain: Không ai cao hơn Nam = Nam cao nhất.
Shall we…? = Why don't we + động từ?

items.prompt: It is a very interesting book.
items.explain: It is a + adj + book = The book is + adj.

items.prompt: Mai's hair is long and black.
items.explain: Her hair is long = She has long hair (tính từ đứng trước danh từ).
Do you have…? = Have you got…?
a fast runner = runs fast (fast vừa là tính từ vừa là trạng từ).

items.prompt: The film was boring, so we left early.
